{{See also|Radxa|List of Single-board computers}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Amlogic]] A311D (ARMv8-A 64-bit) :SoC: Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A73) @2.2GHz :+ Dual-Core ARM (Cortex-A53) @1.8GHz :NPU: 5.0 TOPS @800MHz *GPU: ''Mali-G52'' MP4 @800MHz (OpenGL ES 3.2, OpenCL 2.0) :VPU (with 4K VP9 and 4K 10-bit H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 16GB (eMMC), TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM *Wi-Fi: [[SparkLAN AP6256]] • [[Broadcom]] BCM43456 (1T1R) :SDIO 3.0: Wi-Fi 802.11abgn/ac, UART/PCM: BT 5.0 *USB: 1x USB 2.0 (Type-C OTG), 1x USB 3.0 (Type-C) ports *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: 5V/2A via USB (Type-C OTG)
